question: Neither the paper nor GEO gives the N concentration of the normal-N (NN) and recovery solutions, and they disagree on the base solution (paper: Magnavaca solution; GEO: full-strength Hoagland). N_amount set to NR. Look up?
proposed_answer: Keep NR (N_form nitrate); if needed, ask the authors or adopt the Magnavaca et al. 1987 recipe with a note.
evidence: Paper Methods (PMC12714369): Magnavaca nutrient solution, Ca(NO3)2 replaced by CaCl2 for LN; GEO GSE312408 growth protocol: Hoagland, Ca(NO3)2 and Mg(NO3)2 replaced by CaCl2 and MgSO4

question: LN removes all nitrate salts; neither source says whether any ammonium remained. Coded LN as N_form none, N_amount 0. Accept?
proposed_answer: Accept (nitrate-free LN treated as no-N); revisit if the recipe shows an ammonium salt.
evidence: Paper: 'all nitrate salts were removed from the medium'; GEO: nitrate-limiting solution

question: Aliases T0/T30min/T3h/T1d/T1d30min/T2d decoded as 0, 0.5, 3, 24 h LN and 24.5, 48 h (0.5 and 24 h after nitrate re-supply). Per the project rule, time_h uses one experiment clock (h since nitrate removal): recovery samples are 24.5 and 48 h with phase resupply (re-supply happened at 24 h, so they are 0.5 and 24 h after re-supply). Accept?
proposed_answer: Accept; hours since re-supply (0.5, 24) are stated in curation_note.
evidence: GEO GSE312408 sample titles (e.g. 'T24.5h Leaves 1-NR', 'T48h Root 2-NR') and characteristics time: 0h ... 48h, matched by BioSample; GEO treatment protocol says '24h + 30 min and 24h + 48 h' (the latter conflicts with the 48 h total in titles and paper; taken as 24 h recovery)

question: Paper and GEO disagree on several protocol details: transfer to hydroponics after 3 d (paper) vs 7 DAG (GEO); 10-15 plants pooled (paper) vs 5 (GEO); Epicentre ScriptSeq + HiSeq 2500 (paper) vs NEBNext + NextSeq 2000 (GEO protocol) while SRA/GEO instrument is HiSeq 4000 PE101. Which to record?
proposed_answer: Use the paper for design (pool of 10-15 plants, noted in curation_note with pooled_plants left empty; 15 DAG at treatment) and note SRA instrument; no effect on contrasts since all 36 libraries share one submission.
evidence: PMC12714369 Methods; GSE312408 sample protocols; runs.tsv instrument

question: The paper's RNA-seq methods list only 0.5-48 h, but 6 T0 (NN, 0 h) libraries are deposited. Use T0 as the NN reference for all LN and recovery contrasts?
proposed_answer: Yes: T0 is the only normal-N sample; contrasts LN(t) vs T0 and recovery vs T1d (24 h LN).
evidence: GEO GSM9345258-60 (leaves) and GSM9345276-78 (roots): treatment normal nitrogen, time 0h
